Lift station operators, collection system supervisors, utility maintenance crews, municipal purchasers.

Why this sign matters

Ensures the plow works before the truck rolls out, so failures are found in the bay and not on the route.

Where to post it

Mount on the bay wall in front of the truck cab, within sight of the driver at the hookup.

Who orders it

Plow truck drivers, shop foremen, streets supervisors.

Prevents the fryer lock-out that follows an unseated pan and avoids a service call and lost fry time during a rush.

Mount on the cabinet door above the filter pan or on the fryer base skirt.

Restaurant owners, kitchen managers, line cooks leads, franchise operators, fry cooks.
